why: Six pairs put to the person who asked for this work, on 2026-10-27, with the question and the record and no label, no rule verdict and no reader verdict in front of them. Four of the six were chosen BECAUSE the rule and both readers disagree about them, so this is not a random sample and no kappa should be computed over it: it answers one question - where the rule excuses a near miss and both readers call it unrelated, is a person on the readers' side? - and carries one control, whether the person was paying attention.
labeller: the person who requested the work
sample: enriched for disagreement, deliberately not random
